sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-27B is a 27 billion parameter causal language model with integrated vision encoding, developed by Qwen. The model combines Gated Delta Networks with sparse Mixture-of-Experts to deliver efficient multimodal reasoning and code generation.
